title: T46 contract: animated tier in the avatar pack format (0.4.1)
head: t46-animated-tier
body:
Adds the animated tier to the avatar pack format (T46, decisions #194, #195, #197) and the cross-repo contract every T46 builder reads.

## What
- `docs/formats.md`: optional `tier` (`standard`|`animated`), `frames` 4–12, `fps` 6–12, extra rows `idle_variant_N` then `celebrate` (animated tier only), fallbacks, budgets unchanged. Old packs validate unchanged.
- `docs/t46/contract.md`: manifest keys, validator codes, agent-core `tier` on `GET /avatars`, orb timing (30–90 s, reduced motion = still), "More motion" tag/heading rule, per-repo tests and mutants. §8 settled provisionally (#159).
- 0.4.0 → 0.4.1, CHANGELOG.
